description: This file defines an abstract class 'Endpoint' with generic request and response types, including methods for middleware composition, downstream management, cloning, and static factory methods for creating various dependent endpoint types.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: An abstract class representing an API endpoint with request and response types, supporting middleware, downstream management, cloning, and static factory methods for creating dependent endpoints.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the endpoint logic with the given request, applying middleware.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Transforms the endpoint's request and response types using a provided operator.

methods.name: deepTransform
methods.description: Recursively applies a transformation operator to the endpoint and its downstream.

methods.name: deepTransform (BiFunction overload)
methods.description: Recursively transforms the endpoint and its downstream using a BiFunction.

methods.name: deepDown
methods.description: Recursively collects all downstream endpoints into a set.

methods.name: getMiddleware
methods.description: Returns the current middleware applied to the endpoint.

methods.name: setMiddleware
methods.description: Sets the middleware for the endpoint.

methods.name: composeMiddleware
methods.description: Composes new middleware to be applied before existing middleware.

methods.name: andThenMiddleware
methods.description: Chains new middleware to be applied after existing middleware.

methods.name: overrideMiddleware
methods.description: Replaces existing middleware with new middleware.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the endpoint.

methods.name: withName
methods.description: Creates a copy of the endpoint with a new name.

methods.name: getDownstream
methods.description: Abstract method to get downstream endpoints.

methods.name: withDownstream
methods.description: Abstract method to set downstream endpoints.

methods.name: from (String, NullOperator)
methods.description: Creates an IndependentEndpoint with the given name and filter.

methods.name: from (String, Endpoint, UnaryOperator)
methods.description: Creates a DependentEndpoint with dependencies and an operator.

methods.name: from (String, Endpoint, Endpoint, BinaryOperator)
methods.description: Creates a BiDependentEndpoint with two dependencies and a filter.

methods.name: from (String, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, TernaryOperator)
methods.description: Creates a TriDependentEndpoint with three dependencies and a filter.

methods.name: from (String, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, QuadOperator)
methods.description: Creates a QuadDependentEndpoint with four dependencies and a filter.

methods.name: from (String, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, PentaOperator)
methods.description: Creates a PentaDependentEndpoint with five dependencies and a filter.

methods.name: from (String, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, HexaOperator)
methods.description: Creates a HexaDependentEndpoint with six dependencies and a filter.

methods.name: from (String, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, SeptaOperator)
methods.description: Creates a SeptaDependentEndpoint with seven dependencies and a filter.

methods.name: from (String, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, Endpoint, OctaOperator)
methods.description: Creates an OctaDependentEndpoint with eight dependencies and a filter.
